newsitem.title: CHINA: China to issue 3.5 bln yuan railway bonds.
newsitem.headline: China to issue 3.5 bln yuan railway bonds.

text.p: China's Ministry of Railway plans to soon issue 3.5 billion yuan worth of bonds to help finance expansion of the country's rail system, the China Securities Newspaper said on Tuesday.

The offer has been approved by the State Planning Commission and after the issue, the ministry will apply for the bonds to be listed for trading on one of China's securities exchanges, the newspaper said. It did not give a date for the issue.
The coupon on the three-year and five-year bonds will be slightly higher than that of treasury bonds and China Securities Co has been appointed as the lead underwriter, the newspaper said.
This will be the third set of railway bonds to be issued by China in recent years following two billion yuan worth issued in 1992 and 1.5 billion yuan in 1995, it said.
